description: Unit tests for OLC changeset core types and CRUD operations

tests.name: olccs_create_destroy
tests.description: Create a changeset, verify all fields, then destroy it

tests.name: olccs_add_find_remove
tests.description: Add a change, find it by field path, remove it, verify counts

tests.name: olccs_update_in_place
tests.description: Update same field twice, verify original old_value is preserved

tests.name: olccs_noop_detection
tests.description: Verify no-op detection: same old/new and collapse back to original

tests.name: olccs_clear
tests.description: Add multiple changes, clear all, verify count is zero

tests.name: olccs_safety_limit
tests.description: Fill to OLC_MAX_PENDING_PER_ENTITY and verify next add returns NULL

tests.name: olccs_edit_state_lifecycle
tests.description: Create edit state, add changesets, find, total pending, destroy

tests.name: olccs_numeric_types
tests.description: Test integer, boolean, and flags field types with JSON values

tests.name: olccs_list_add_remove
tests.description: ADD then REMOVE for same list item collapses to no-op

tests.name: olccs_list_add_update
tests.description: ADD then UPDATE for same item collapses to ADD with updated value

tests.name: olccs_list_remove_add
tests.description: REMOVE then ADD for same key collapses to UPDATE

tests.name: olccs_list_update_update
tests.description: UPDATE then UPDATE keeps original old_value, updates new_value

tests.name: olccs_list_update_remove
tests.description: UPDATE then REMOVE collapses to REMOVE with original old_value

tests.name: olccs_fh_lookup
tests.description: Look up field handlers by exact path

tests.name: olccs_wildcard_match
tests.description: Wildcard field path matching (exits/* matches exits/north)

tests.name: olccs_apply_string
tests.description: Generic string apply with free_string/str_dup

tests.name: olccs_apply_int
tests.description: Generic int apply from JSON integer

tests.name: olccs_apply_bool
tests.description: Generic bool apply from JSON boolean

tests.name: olccs_apply_flags
tests.description: Generic flags apply from JSON integer

tests.name: olccs_commit_basic
tests.description: Commit changeset applies all changes to entity

tests.name: olccs_revert
tests.description: Revert single field and revert all pending changes

tests.name: olccs_staged_string
tests.description: Staged string preview returns staged value when pending

tests.name: olccs_staged_int
tests.description: Staged int preview returns staged value when pending

tests.name: olccs_staged_flags
tests.description: Staged flags preview returns staged value when pending

tests.name: olccs_staged_bool
tests.description: Staged bool preview returns staged value when pending

tests.name: olccs_is_field_staged
tests.description: olc_is_field_staged returns true only for changed fields

tests.name: olccs_serialize_roundtrip
tests.description: Serialize changeset to JSON and deserialize back with all data intact

tests.name: olccs_serialize_empty
tests.description: Serialize and deserialize an empty changeset preserves metadata

tests.name: olccs_deserialize_corrupt
tests.description: Deserialize rejects NULL, arrays, partial objects, and wrong types

tests.name: olccs_draft_save_load
tests.description: Save draft to disk, load it back, verify contents, then discard

tests.name: olccs_commit_all_types
tests.description: Commit changeset applies all 5 scalar field types via macro-generated handlers
